subject: pharmacology
title: Corticosteroids: potency, Cushing, taper and uses

steps.tx: **Corticosteroids** act genomically (hours, transrepression of inflammation) and non-genomically (pulses); potency sorts duration: **hydrocortisone** (short, mineralocorticoid full, replacement), **prednisolone** (intermediate, workhorse), **dexamethasone and betamethasone** (long, no mineralocorticoid, cerebral oedema and fetal lung), **fludrocortisone** (pure mineralocorticoid, Addison and salt wasting). Dose equivalence (hydrocortisone 20 equals prednisolone 5 equals dexamethasone 0.75) converts.
steps.say: Short hydrocortisone replaces, intermediate prednisolone works, long dexamethasone oedemas. Fludrocortisone salts.

steps.tx: **Iatrogenic Cushing** (commonest cause: prescriptions, central obesity with striae, hypertension, glucose intolerance, cataract, psychosis) reverses on taper while endogenous (pituitary, adrenal, ectopic) works up separately. **Adrenal suppression** (weeks of steroids blunt HPA) demands **taper** (alternate day, slow below physiological) with **stress cover** (double or triple perioperative and febrile illness, parenteral if vomiting); abrupt stops crisis (hypotension, hyponatraemia, shock). Sick day rules card every chronic user.
steps.say: Weeks of steroids blunt adrenals: taper slow, double sick days. Stopping abruptly crises.

steps.tx: **Systemic uses** target inflammation and immunity: asthma and COPD exacerbations (prednisolone bursts), rheumatoid and IBD flares, **multiple sclerosis relapse** (methylprednisolone pulses), **cerebral oedema** around tumours (dexamethasone), **Pneumocystis hypoxia** (adjunct saving), **TB meningitis** (dexamethasone mortality benefit), ALL induction, transplant rejection, anaphylaxis adjunct (adrenaline leads). Pulses treat flares; maintenance seeks sparers (methotrexate, azathioprine, biologics).
steps.say: MS relapse pulses methylprednisolone; tumour oedema dexamethasones; TB meningitis steroids save. Sparers maintain.

steps.tx: **Adverse shield** anticipates: hyperglycaemia (diabetes screen), **osteoporosis** (calcium, vitamin D, bisphosphonates, DEXA), cataract with glaucoma (eye checks), psychosis and mania, **avascular necrosis** hips, skin thinning with striae, weight gain. **Inhaled** (beclomethasone, budesonide; rinse mouth preventing **candidiasis**, spacer technique) and topical (fingertip units, potency ladders, tachyphylaxis) localise benefit. Live vaccines wait immunosuppression out.
steps.say: Steroid bones thin: calcium, D, bisphosphonate, DEXA. Inhalers rinse: thrush follows otherwise.
